messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-inference-inference-gateway (env=prod, region=eu-west1). Signal: http_5xx_rate. Current: 8.3% (threshold 5%). auto-pager: true

pagerduty: Incident #PD-83412 opened and paging the on-call rotation. Escalation policy: inference-gateway-prod. Links: https://pd.internal/incidents/PD-83412

sara_oncall: acked the page :white_check_mark: I'm on it. Initial triage: is this across all regions or just eu-west1?

dylan: i'm seeing correlated alerts from lb-layer (keepalive errors) and from kv-cache eviction logs. eu-west1 only so far. tagging @maria for routing config check.

maria: checking recent changes — there was a canary deploy of ingress-proxy v2.3.1 ~10m ago to eu-west1 (only half the nodes). No other deploys. Rolling back that canary?

ops_lead_jess: please hold on rollback for now, want a quick triage. Can we confirm customer impact before rolling? sara, any front-line CS tickets?

sara_oncall: CS: zero new tickets right now, but synthetic monitor for /v1/generate shows increased 502s. Quick check from health endpoint shows 200, but the request path with longer contexts fails.

ben: copying a short log snippet from one ingress pod (filtered):

```
E0315 12:14:43.123 1 http2: server: write tcp 10.0.0.12:443: write: connection reset by peer
W0315 12:14:43.125 1 keepalive: client keepalive mismatch; resetting connection
E0315 12:14:44.512 1 upstream: 502 upstream read timeout
```

infra-bot: autoscale-signal: small spike in pod restarts for ingress-proxy (eu-west1) - CPU and mem normal, but connections high.

dylan: hypothesize: ingress-proxy upgrade exposed a keepalive semantics mismatch with our edge LB -> results in connection resets and cascade retries generating 5xx rate. Could also be a retry amplification.

maria: confirming LB config shows idle_timeout=30s while new proxy uses default 60s. Mismatch could cause half-open connections.

ops_lead_jess: action plan (short): 1) temporarily route eu-west1 traffic to fallback pool (reduce user impact) 2) pause canary on ingress-proxy and force previous stable 2.3.0 3) reduce client-side retry window to avoid amplification. Who can run route toggle?

ben: I can flip the route to fallback pool (takes ~30s). Running command: `rctl route set inference-gateway --region eu-west1 --weight fallback-pool=100 --reason "5xx spike"`

infra-bot: command accepted. Routing change in progress... new weights applied in 18s.

sara_oncall: after reroute, synthetic 502 rate dropped to 1.2% in 60s sample. Customer impact looks reduced. Good call.

dylan: pausing canary now. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/ingress-proxy --namespace=prod --to-revision=2`

maria: rollback started, 4/8 pods replaced, expecting full rollback in ~2m.

incidentbot: Note: PD incident update: mitigation actions initiated (routing fallback + canary rollback). Please update status if customer impact changes.

ops_lead_jess: while rollback completes, let's capture a quick diagnostic to validate root cause: run a controlled curl through the old and new ingress and compare keepalive behavior. Example: 

```
# long-poll test, 5s between chunks
curl -v -N --keepalive-time 20 'https://eu-west1.api.redwood/v1/generate?prompt=___LONG__' -o /tmp/out
```

ben: ran the test against new proxy: saw connection reset after ~32s. Ran against rolled-back proxy: connection persisted >90s. That matches timeout mismatch theory.

dylan: confidence=high. Root cause: ingress-proxy v2.3.1 changed keepalive default which doesn't align with LB idle_timeout -> partial connections reset -> upstream 502s + retry amplification.

maria: final steps: 1) keep fallback routing until all nodes are on stable 2.3.0 or we deploy a config fix 2) add preflight check in canary pipeline to validate keepalive semantics vs LB 3) create an alert to detect sudden rise in connection resets (before 5xx threshold)

ops_lead_jess: agreed. Sara, can you prepare the customer update? mention that we responded quickly and mitigations are in place; no major customer incidents reported, but some requests saw transient 502s earlier.

sara_oncall: drafting now: "We experienced a short-lived increase in 502 responses in eu-west1 tied to an internal proxy canary. Traffic has been routed to a fallback pool and the canary rolled back. We're monitoring and will follow up with a post-mortem." Will send to #customers if approved.

pagerduty: PD-83412: status updated to "Mitigated" by sara_oncall. Escalation halted.

incidentbot: Reminder: please collect the following for postmortem: canary rollout details, router weight timeline, pod-level logs (keepalive/reset traces), synthetic monitor deltas, and the runbook link: https://playbook.internal/runbooks/ingress-keepalive-mismatch

dylan: adding one postmortem note — we should consider lowering canary batch size for networking infra changes and add an automated LB compatibility check.

ben: logs and synthetic charts uploaded to the incident folder: https://internal.storage/incidents/PD-83412-logs

maria: I'll open a PR to add the preflight check and a test harness for keepalive semantics. ETA EOD.

ops_lead_jess: great work team. I'll schedule a 15m blameless postmortem tomorrow to cover action items and assign owners. Closing messages in 30m unless anything regresses. :thumbsup:

sara_oncall: marking incident as resolved in Slack thread. Will post the customer note in 10m once legal/cs OK.

incidentbot: PD-83412 closed by sara_oncall (duration ~24m).
